run_metadata.coverage_summary: Swept all nine Tier-1 government portals (AusTender, buy.nsw/NSW eTendering, Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) plus VendorPanel Public Tenders and the mandatory Tier-3 channel (SAP Ariba Discovery) via web search. Tier-2 GBE/energy networks (Ausgrid, Transgrid/iBuy, Western Power, Sydney/Melbourne Water, WaterNSW, Australia Post) and universities (ANU) were sampled. As in recent runs, direct page fetching was blocked environment-wide: every government portal and each AusTender/NSW eTendering detail page returned HTTP 403 (anti-bot wall) to the non-browser client, so opportunity detail could only be captured from search-index snippets, not from buyers' own detail pages or tender documents. One genuinely new opportunity surfaced and was grounded to a specific AusTender ATM: LAND 4140 (WP-16) Tactical Edge Radio (Defence CASG, JSD/RFT/76225/1, closing 4-Sep-2026). Two recently-tracked open Commonwealth/NSW items (HealthShare NSW natural gas RFT; ANSTO ILWCI+ upcoming RFT) were re-confirmed as still active. One genuinely new buyer-originated source was discovered: DFAT's AusConnect development-program portal. Tier-3 corporate channels were checked and remain registration- or invitation-gated with no publicly-visible RFx; recorded as a portal, not fabricated as tenders.
gaps: WebFetch returned HTTP 403 (Forbidden) for Tier-1 portal search and detail pages, e.g. https://www.tenders.nsw.gov.au/?event=public.RFT.show&RFTUUID=6BF43C78-EF02-348D-2654E05C7AAA3F38 . Portals continue to enforce anti-bot protection against non-browser clients in this environment, so full deliverables/requirements/eligibility/contact extraction from buyer detail pages and tender documents was not possible this run. All tender detail below is from public search-index snippets and is headline-level / pending verification.

Tenders WA, QTenders (QLD), Tenders SA, NT QTOL and ACT Tenders were reachable only via search-index summaries; no new jurisdiction-specific opportunities could be confirmed at detail level beyond items already recorded in prior runs. A Tenders WA planned outage was noted for Wed 5 Aug 2026 17:00-19:00.
VendorPanel Public Tenders individual RFQ/RFT detail remains behind supplier login; only council landing pages were visible. No new council opportunity could be grounded at detail level this run.

Tier-3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, banks, telcos, energy retailers): no publicly-visible RFx surfaced without login. These channels are registration-gated (Ariba/Coupa/RangeMe) or invitation-only; per spec the portal is recorded in discovered_sources and no corporate opportunities were invented.

DFAT AusConnect (newly discovered) lists a 'DEV+ Panel' tender opportunity and DFAT's development pipeline flags upcoming market approaches (Australian Volunteers Program from mid-2027; Timor-Leste labour mobility managing contractor). Opportunity detail sits behind the AusConnect portal and DFAT's major procurements run via AusTender; these were not captured as tenders to avoid fabricating dates/scope, and are noted here instead.
Invitation-only management-consultancy RFPs (Accenture/KPMG/Deloitte-style) are out of scope by definition (never published) and were not sought as tenders.
recommended_seed_additions: DFAT AusConnect — https://ausconnect.dfat.gov.au/ (Commonwealth aid/development-program subcontracting and panel opportunities; buyer-originated, not an aggregator; complements DFAT's AusTender notices). Not previously in the known-source list.

DFAT Development Procurement Pipeline — https://www.dfat.gov.au/about-us/business-opportunities/development-procurement-pipeline (forward notice of upcoming aid market approaches; useful market-sounding signal).

tenders.title: LAND 4140 Submission 2 — Work Package WP-16: Tactical Communications Network (TCN) Tactical Edge Radio (TER)
tenders.buyer: Department of Defence — Capability Acquisition and Sustainment Group (CASG)
tenders.description: Commonwealth Request for Tender under Defence project LAND 4140 (Submission 2), Work Package WP-16, for a Tactical Communications Network (TCN) Tactical Edge Radio (TER) capability. Responses are lodged electronically on AusTender against ATM JSD/RFT/76225/1.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Supply of a Tactical Edge Radio capability for the Australian Defence Force's Tactical Communications Network under LAND 4140 (WP-16). Exact scope, quantities, delivery and support requirements are set out in the RFT documents on AusTender, which were not accessible in this environment (HTTP 403); captured at headline level from the AusTender search index.
tenders.submission_method: Electronic lodgement via AusTender against ATM JSD/RFT/76225/1
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via AusTender web search for current Defence approaches to market; grounded to the buyer-originated AusTender ATM detail URL (ATM ID JSD/RFT/76225/1). Genuinely new to this routine (not present in prior aggregate). A related LAND 4140 Submission 3 ATM (Land4140S3CCISTS-2V1) also appeared but its status/detail were ambiguous and it was not captured.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only. Buyer, ATM ID, category, closing date/time and submission method are from the AusTender search index; the ATM detail page and RFT documents returned HTTP 403 in this environment, so deliverables, requirements, value, evaluation criteria and contact remain to be extracted in an authenticated/browser run.

tenders.title: Supply of Natural Gas to Large Public Hospitals in NSW
tenders.category: Building and property — Utilities and Energy

tenders.deliverables_summary: Supply of natural gas (energy commodity) to large public hospital sites across NSW. Detailed site list, volumes, contract structure and metering/service requirements are in the RFT documents on NSW eTendering, which were not accessible in this environment (HTTP 403).
tenders.delivery_location: New South Wales (large public hospital sites)
tenders.reasoning: Re-confirmed still open via NSW eTendering / buy.nsw web search; previously recorded by this routine (agency ref HSSP_HC26_C676). Buyer-originated NSW eTendering listing. Retained to keep active status current as the 13-Aug-2026 close approaches.
tenders.notes: Headline-level. Closing date 13-Aug-2026 confirmed from search index; eTendering deep-link detail page returned HTTP 403 so deliverables, value, contacts and documents could not be extracted. A search snippet loosely tagged an agency of 'Transport Infrastructure Projects' which is inconsistent with the subject matter and treated as index noise — buyer recorded as HealthShare NSW consistent with prior runs and the tender reference.

tenders.title: ANSTO Intermediate Level Waste Capacity Increase (ILWCI+) Project — Industry Briefing / Upcoming RFT
tenders.buyer: Australian Nuclear Science and Technology Organisation (ANSTO)
tenders.category: Nuclear waste management / construction & engineering services
tenders.description: AusTender industry-briefing notice for ANSTO's Intermediate Level Waste Capacity Increase (ILWCI+) Project, flagging an upcoming open Request for Tender. Registration to attend the industry briefing closed 4:00 pm AEST 29 July 2026; the formal RFT is anticipated to be released via an open approach to market in early August 2026.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Early market engagement ahead of a formal RFT for works/services to increase ANSTO's intermediate-level nuclear waste storage capacity at Lucas Heights. Full scope will be defined in the forthcoming RFT documents; briefing attendance is voluntary and not a precondition to responding to any future RFT.
tenders.eligibility: Open — briefing attendance voluntary and not a condition of participating in any subsequent approach to market.
tenders.briefing: Industry briefing — registration of interest closed 4:00 PM AEST 29 July 2026 (attendance voluntary).
tenders.submission_method: Forthcoming open RFT to be published on AusTender (early August 2026)
tenders.reasoning: Re-checked via AusTender search; previously recorded by this routine (ATM PSC002897/Brief). Retained because the associated open RFT was anticipated in early August 2026 — worth watching this window for the formal approach to market.
tenders.notes: Headline-level. Briefing registration deadline (29 Jul 2026) and 'early August 2026' RFT timing are from the AusTender search index; the ATM detail page returned HTTP 403 so scope/documents could not be extracted. The formal ILWCI+ RFT had not surfaced as a separate open ATM at run time.

discovered_sources.how_discovered: Surfaced while searching for Australian university/aid procurement; ausconnect.dfat.gov.au is operated by the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade to advertise subcontracting, panel (e.g. DEV+ Panel) and employment opportunities on Australian aid/development contracts. Buyer-originated (DFAT), not an aggregator; complements DFAT's major-procurement notices on AusTender.
discovered_sources.notes: New to this routine. A 'DEV+ Panel' tender opportunity is listed; individual opportunity detail sits behind the portal and DFAT's headline procurements are also published on AusTender. Pair with the DFAT Development Procurement Pipeline (https://www.dfat.gov.au/about-us/business-opportunities/development-procurement-pipeline) for forward market-approach signals (e.g. Australian Volunteers Program from mid-2027; Timor-Leste labour mobility managing contractor).

discovered_sources.source_name: SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery
discovered_sources.how_discovered: Checked each run as the mandatory Tier-3 corporate channel — the public posting board where buyers post open RFx. No Australia-specific publicly-visible RFx surfaced via web search this run; full opportunity detail requires a free supplier account (registration-gated).
discovered_sources.notes: Known source, re-verified to document Tier-3 coverage. Corporate opportunities on Ariba Discovery (and buyer instances such as Transgrid iBuy, Western Power, NBN Co, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas Coupa) remain registration- or invitation-gated; recorded as portals, never fabricated as tenders. An authenticated run is required to read individual events.
